Name: Stock Day Summary
Description: At the end of every stock market day shows how much your portfolio gained or lost, with an optional auto-pause. Settings: Main Menu → Mod Settings → Stock Day Summary.
DescriptionSteam:
[h1]Stock Day Summary[/h1]
At the end of every stock market day the mod shows how much your portfolio gained or lost — and can pause the game so you never miss it.

[h2]What you get[/h2]
[list]
[*]An entry in the Events list: [b]Stock market day: +$3.12K (+4.64%)[/b], green or red
[*]Click it for details: day result, portfolio value, realized profit from sales, unrealized profit and a per-asset breakdown
[*]The same line in the event log
[*]Optional auto-pause when the summary appears, and an optional autosave right before the day closes
[/list]

[h2]How it counts[/h2]
The day result compares the price that held during the finished market day with the new price set at the day boundary. Shares bought during the day count from their purchase price, shares sold during the day count at their sale price. Start-of-day prices come from the game's own price history, so the summary is correct right after loading a save (only sales made before loading are unknown).

[h2]Settings[/h2]
Main Menu → Mod Settings → Stock Day Summary (the menu of [b]Modding Overhauled[/b] if you have it, otherwise the mod adds its own button):
[list]
[*]Pause on stock day summary (on by default)
[*]Open details window immediately
[*]Report days without stocks
[*]Autosave before the day closes (the game's own autosave, 10 game minutes before the boundary)
[/list]

Translations: English, Russian. Safe to add to an existing save and to remove later — the mod stores nothing in saves.

[h1]Сводка биржи[/h1]
В конце каждого биржевого дня мод показывает, сколько портфель заработал или потерял, и может поставить игру на паузу.

[list]
[*]Событие в списке «События»: [b]Биржа за день: +$3.12K (+4.64%)[/b]
[*]По клику — итог дня, стоимость портфеля, зафиксированная продажами и нереализованная прибыль, разбивка по активам
[*]Строка в журнале событий
[*]Пауза при сводке и автосохранение перед закрытием дня (в настройках)
[/list]

Настройки: главное меню → Настройки модов (Mod Settings) → Сводка биржи. Если установлен Modding Overhauled, пункт появится в его меню, иначе мод добавит свою кнопку. Мод ничего не пишет в сохранения, его можно добавить в текущую игру и убрать в любой момент.

Исходный код (MIT): [url=https://github.com/Gesugao-san/stardeus-stock-day-summary]GitHub[/url]. Ошибки и предложения — в issues.
